cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says every registered birth across the country receives the number, or puts birth registration at all births and deaths at 80% or more.
cells.note: Stage 4c: a 2024 Pay Research Bureau report says the Civil Status Division's database generates a unique identification number at birth registration, stage 3. It is a general statement, not evidence that every registered birth across the country receives the number, which stage 4 must show.
